card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger. No need to ask why I'm taking so long.

mechanism: A recruits another person's reading, presence and physical guidance to bear difficult news without naming the full emotional burden.
confusable: Unlike merely asking for literacy help, the interaction must make the request a way to share anticipated distress.
comparison: D97-b uses facial reaction and following a finger; D97-a uses canceling a table and packing anniversary glasses.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
